ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.role: joiner for the agent-name list inside the built-in installation offer
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.tone: neutral inline enumeration; preserve agent names verbatim, no sentence punctuation
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.length: Two placeholders plus separators: three characters for pair/final joins, two for middle joins; width otherwise depends on the names.
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.note: Spanish uses y without a preceding comma for pairs and final items, and comma-space between middle items, consistent with existing catalogue lists. Before a name beginning with the /i/ sound, Spanish requires e instead of y (not before the /je/ sound). The fixed position-only select cannot detect the following name's pronunciation; phonetic alternation requires caller support and is not encoded by this entry.

placeholders.position: pair for exactly two names, middle for intermediate joins, other for the final join in a longer list
placeholders.head: first agent name or already joined partial list; preserve verbatim
